name: awaaz-shield
description: Awaaz Shield - live scam-call detection. One command starts the FastAPI backend and the React frontend.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --kill-signal SIGTERM --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta --prefix "[{name}]" "node scripts/run-backend.mjs" "node scripts/run-frontend.mjs"
scripts.dev:share: concurrently --kill-others --kill-signal SIGTERM --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta --prefix "[{name}]" "node scripts/run-backend.mjs" "node scripts/run-frontend.mjs --share"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
